difficulty_notes: 7-file diff (refactors + small features) with 6 planted defects: off-by-one dropping a trailing single-element chunk, lock released between read and write, f-string SQL for a new category filter while the term stays parameterised, mutable default list that is mutated, broad except that now swallows malformed lines despite the docstring, datetime.now() (local) compared with naive-UTC timestamps. 3 harmless look-alikes (range(0,x)->range(x), acquire/try/finally->with, logging f-string) and a pure-refactor file. Score: per bug location (+-3 lines, weight 1) + category (0.5); per harmless change no finding (1); -0.05 per stray finding beyond 2.
